_note: A root `{#snippet}` is hoisted to the start of the render function as its real `const NAME = (params) => …` (upstream moves it to the script's start), so a script that uses it — here as a `$props()` default typed `Snippet<[string]>` while the snippet takes a `number` — is checked against its real signature. We forward-declared root snippets as `any`, hiding the mismatch.
